{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
sales = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Confirm no QA orders (should be 0)
qa_orders = (sales['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99).sum()
print("Number of QA orders after cleaning:", qa_orders)

# Confirm no refunded orders are included in revenue
refunded_count = (sales['status'] == 'refunded').sum()
print("Number of refunded orders:", refunded_count)

# Check for any remaining issues
print("Unique channels:", sales['channel'].unique())"}
